remarks: Introducing 33 Barholm, a charming ranch-style home nestled in Upper Springdale, perfect for anyone looking for a little suburban bliss blended w/convenient living! Let's start w/the heart of any home: the kitchen, updated w/gleaming granite counters & SS appliances which are ready for your culinary adventures. Moving through the home, you'll find a living room made for relaxation, boasting a welcoming fireplace as its centerpiece. Imagine chilly evenings spent here, hot cocoa in hand, as the fire crackles warmly. Adjacent to this is the dining room, ideal for meals filled w/laughter & family gatherings which leads into a sunny den versatile to suit your needs. The main level is complete w/2 spacious bdrms & a full bth. The 3rd bdrm is up a half flight of stairs w/plenty of storage & an ensuite powder room. Addtl features include: recessed lighting, crown molding, hardwood floors, c/a & a full generator. 1 car attached garage & a huge full bsmnt. Bonus.. natural gas has been brought to the house! Last, but certainly not least is your backyard haven. Step out onto the new Trex deck which is perfect for summer BBQs! Beyond the deck is like having your own private park, fully fenced for privacy & peace of mind. Whether you're into gardening, playing fetch or watching the kids run around, this yard has got you covered. Conveniently located just over a mile to the Springdale Train, short drive to the Merritt Prkwy, schools & all your conveniences on High Ridge. Welcome Home!!
